verdict.rationale: The product documents one-line install routes: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, plus Claude Code, Codex and Copilot plugin commands, with 'Install the ones you want, then type a slash command' guidance. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed a real non-interactive install of the `tdd` skill that read back cleanly. Nothing documents or measures the under-five-minutes target, and there is no dedicated step-by-step quickstart page, so the story's time-bound onboarding claim is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented or measured time-to-first-working-skill under five minutes, a dedicated quickstart walkthrough including first skill invocation, independent user reports of onboarding speed.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes

citations.quote: npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills Update with npx skills update
Install the ones you want, then type a slash command.
claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official ... Updates itself by default.
the documented skills.sh install path works non-interactively, exactly as the README promises.
